cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是 BBC 世界服务部的《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: I'm Alex Ritson, and in the early hours of Friday, the 21st of August, these are our main stories.
cues.zh: 我是 Alex Ritson。8月21日星期五凌晨，以下是我们的主要新闻。

cues.en: Key Western leaders, excluding the US, jointly condemn Israel's settlement project that would cut off the Palestinian West Bank from East Jerusalem.
cues.zh: 不包括美国在内的西方主要领导人联合谴责以色列的定居点项目，该项目将切断巴勒斯坦约旦河西岸与东耶路撒冷的联系。

cues.en: Reports from Pakistan say former Prime Minister Imran Khan has been returned to jail after a court-ordered visit to hospital.
cues.zh: 来自巴基斯坦的报道说，前总理 Imran Khan 在法院下令前往医院后被送回监狱。

cues.en: And the World Health Organization says it's sending 70,000 vaccine doses to help tackle the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo.
cues.zh: 世界卫生组织表示，将向刚果民主共和国运送7万剂疫苗，帮助应对埃博拉疫情。

cues.en: Also in this podcast, the US piles pressure on Cuba by slapping it with yet more sanctions.
cues.zh: 本期节目还将关注：美国对古巴施加更多制裁，进一步加大压力。

cues.en: And I don't think it's helpful for people to think that they have to slog on with something they're not enjoying.
cues.zh: 我不认为让人们觉得必须苦撑着读自己不喜欢的东西会有帮助。

cues.en: I think it'd be better to move on to something else and think that reading should just be a pleasure.
cues.zh: 我觉得不如换读别的东西，并认为阅读就应该是一种享受。

cues.en: The debate about whether it's okay to not finish reading books.
cues.zh: 这场争论讨论的是，读书读不完是否也没关系。

cues.en: Not for the first time, major Western powers have united to rebuke Israel over Jewish settlement activity in the occupied West Bank.
cues.zh: 这不是西方大国第一次联合起来，就以色列在被占领约旦河西岸的犹太人定居活动严厉谴责以色列。

cues.en: They're demanding that Israel immediately stop a bidding process to build around 1,200 homes in the settlement called E1
cues.zh: 他们要求以色列立即停止在名为 E1 的定居点修建约1,200套住房的招标程序

cues.en: which would cut off occupied East Jerusalem from the West Bank.
cues.zh: 该项目将切断被占领的东耶路撒冷与约旦河西岸的联系。

cues.en: Israel's far-right finance minister, Bezalel Smotrich, previously said that E1 would bury the idea of a Palestinian state.
cues.zh: 以色列极右翼财政部长 Bezalel Smotrich 此前说过，E1 将埋葬建立巴勒斯坦国的想法。

cues.en: Israel's closest ally, the United States, isn't one of the Western powers condemning Israel.
cues.zh: 以色列最亲密的盟友美国，并不在谴责以色列的西方国家之列。

cues.en: Our diplomatic correspondent Caroline Hawley told me which ones were.
cues.zh: 我们的外交事务记者 Caroline Hawley 告诉我，参与的国家有哪些。

cues.en: It's the UK, France, Germany, Italy, the Netherlands, Canada, and Norway. They have voiced grave concerns.
cues.zh: 它们是英国、法国、德国、意大利、荷兰、加拿大和挪威。这些国家表达了严重关切。

cues.en: They say privately and publicly about this E1 project.
cues.zh: 他们私下和公开都谈到了 E1 项目。

cues.en: They say it would drive a wedge through the West Bank and undermine prospects for a two-state solution—a state for Palestinians as well as Israel.
cues.zh: 他们说，这会撕裂约旦河西岸，破坏两国方案的前景，也就是既属于巴勒斯坦人、也属于以色列的国家。

cues.en: They say that under international law it is clear that settlements in the West Bank are illegal.
cues.zh: 他们说，根据国际法，约旦河西岸的定居点显然属于非法。

cues.en: They say this comes at a time of unprecedented violence by settlers in the West Bank, and they urge Israel to retract.
cues.zh: 他们说，此时约旦河西岸正发生前所未有的定居者暴力，并敦促以色列撤回这些计划。

cues.en: And they say that these plans further undermine its international standing.
cues.zh: 他们还说，这些计划将进一步损害以色列的国际地位。

cues.en: Now, very interestingly as well, they also have a warning to construction companies, and I'm going to quote.
cues.zh: 此外，有意思的是，他们还向建筑公司发出警告。我来引用原文。

cues.en: They say, ‘Businesses should not consider bidding for construction tenders.’
cues.zh: 他们说：“企业不应考虑竞标建筑工程。”

cues.en: They should be aware of legal and reputational consequences, including the risk of involving themselves in serious breaches of international law.’
cues.zh: 企业应意识到法律和声誉后果，包括可能卷入严重违反国际法行为的风险。”

cues.en: So it's a strong statement. The Israeli government is presumably unmoved?
cues.zh: 所以这是一份措辞强硬的声明。以色列政府想必无动于衷？

cues.en: The Israeli government has not commented, but Britain strongly criticized it before this joint statement.
cues.zh: 目前以色列政府尚未置评，但英国在这份联合声明之前就已提出强烈批评。

cues.en: The Israeli Chargé d'Affaires was called in to hear of Britain's profound objection to the E1 plans and these construction tenders.
cues.zh: 以色列代办被召见，听取英国对 E1 计划和这些建筑招标的强烈反对。

cues.en: Israeli Foreign Minister Gideon Sa'ar called it absurd for the UK to lecture Jewish people on where they can live.
cues.zh: 以色列外长 Gideon Sa'ar 回应说，英国竟教训犹太人应该住在哪里，实在荒谬。

cues.en: Is this statement likely to make any difference at all?
cues.zh: 这份声明究竟可能带来任何改变吗？

cues.en: This is a difficult question. I think statements alone will not make a difference.
cues.zh: 这是个很难回答的问题。我认为仅靠声明不会带来改变。

cues.en: Ed Miliband, the British Foreign Secretary, has said that in the coming weeks there will be further measures, including sanctions.
cues.zh: 英国外交大臣 Ed Miliband 说，未来几周还会采取包括制裁在内的进一步措施。

cues.en: But it's interesting, I was just looking at a statement from the Israeli group Peace Now, which is opposed to settlements
cues.zh: 不过有意思的是，我刚看到以色列反对定居点组织 Peace Now 的一份声明

cues.en: and it says that the bidding period closes a week before the Israeli elections in October.
cues.zh: 声明说，招标期将在10月以色列大选前一周结束。

cues.en: So we're in an election period. The statement says the current Israeli government is trying to sign contracts with contractors before the elections
cues.zh: 所以现在正值选举期，声明还说，以色列现政府正试图在选举前与承包商签订合同

cues.en: so that it'll be much harder for the next government to cancel the construction. So that's their viewpoint.
cues.zh: 这样下一届政府就会更难取消建设。这就是他们的观点。

cues.en: What position have other nations taken?
cues.zh: 其他国家采取了什么立场？

cues.en: Well, interestingly, not on the list of the countries signing this joint statement is the US, of course.
cues.zh: 有意思的是，当然，美国并不在签署这份联合声明的国家名单上。

cues.en: Because it has the greatest sway.
cues.zh: 因为美国拥有最大的影响力。

cues.en: But you have had the US ambassador to Israel, Mike Huckabee, who is a supporter of settlements
cues.zh: 但美国驻以色列大使 Mike Huckabee 是定居点支持者

cues.en: being very, very critical of recent violence that we've seen being meted out by settlers against Palestinians.
cues.zh: 他一直严厉批评近期定居者对巴勒斯坦人施加的暴力。

cues.en: Caroline Hawley.
cues.zh: Caroline Hawley 报道。

cues.en: Pakistan's former prime minister and one-time legendary cricketer Imran Khan
cues.zh: 巴基斯坦前总理、曾经的传奇板球运动员伊姆兰·汗

cues.en: has been in jail for three years on what he says are politically motivated corruption charges.
cues.zh: 因他所称的出于政治动机的腐败指控入狱已有三年。

cues.en: Earlier this morning, he was moved to hospital for health checkups on the orders of the Supreme Court.
cues.zh: 今天早些时候，他根据最高法院的命令被送往医院接受健康检查。

cues.en: His family say his health is failing.
cues.zh: 他的家人说，他的健康状况正在恶化。

cues.en: The government, though, isn't convinced and tried to keep him behind bars.
cues.zh: 但政府并不相信，并试图把他继续关在狱中。

cues.en: And now, after only a few hours in hospital, reports from Pakistan say Imran Khan has been taken back to prison.
cues.zh: 现在，据巴基斯坦方面报道，伊姆兰·汗在医院仅待了几小时后就被带回监狱。

cues.en: Our Pakistan correspondent Carrie Davies told me more about the background to the latest move.
cues.zh: 我们的巴基斯坦记者凯莉·戴维斯向我介绍了这一最新动向的背景。

cues.en: That movement has prompted lots of people to start speculating here in Islamabad.
cues.zh: 这一动向促使伊斯兰堡的许多人开始猜测。

cues.en: Quite often, when there are decisions being made by the courts
cues.zh: 通常，当法院作出决定时

cues.en: that go against Mr Khan, his party will talk about this being politically motivated.
cues.zh: 如果决定对汗先生不利，他的政党就会称其出于政治动机。

cues.en: However, in this particular case, where it seems to have gone in his favour,
cues.zh: 然而，在这起看似对他有利的特殊案件中，

cues.en: they have not commented on the speculation that there could be political manoeuvrings going on behind the scenes.
cues.zh: 他们没有对幕后可能存在政治运作的猜测发表评论。

cues.en: What is incredibly difficult to say from where we're standing is what is actually going on behind the scenes.
cues.zh: 我们身处现场，却很难说清幕后究竟发生了什么。

cues.en: Is this entirely to do with Mr Khan's health?
cues.zh: 这完全是因为汗先生的健康状况吗？

cues.en: Certainly, his family have not seen him for months.
cues.zh: 可以肯定的是，他的家人已经数月没有见到他。

cues.en: They want to make sure that his health is fine, and they want to have that reassurance by his own personal physician.
cues.zh: 他们想确认他的健康状况良好，并希望由他的私人医生给予保证。

cues.en: He was the most famous man in Pakistan by a very long way.
cues.zh: 他曾是当之无愧的巴基斯坦最知名人士。

cues.en: He was the prime minister, he was a major sportsman.
cues.zh: 他曾是总理，也是一位杰出的运动员。

cues.en: If he did get out of jail more permanently, is he still a political contender?
cues.zh: 如果他最终获释，他仍然是政治竞争者吗？

cues.en: Mr Khan is probably one of the most famous sons of Pakistan.
cues.zh: 汗先生可能是巴基斯坦最著名的人物之一。

cues.en: He is still incredibly popular.
cues.zh: 他仍然极受欢迎。

cues.en: And even though he has not been in public view for the course of the last three years,
cues.zh: 尽管过去三年他一直没有公开露面，

cues.en: his party have tried as much as they can to keep him in the public consciousness.
cues.zh: 他的政党仍尽力让公众记住他。

cues.en: The fact that they have been able to keep his sort of social media following going, he obviously has a huge number of supporters as well around the world,
cues.zh: 他们能够维持他在社交媒体上的追随者群体；显然，他在世界各地也有大量支持者，

cues.en: as well, of course, his family, who have been repeatedly talking about the fact that he is still in prison. So he has not totally drifted from public consciousness.
cues.zh: 当然，他的家人也一再谈到他仍在狱中。因此，他并没有完全淡出公众视野。

cues.en: I think he is still politically popular.
cues.zh: 我认为他在政治上仍然受欢迎。

cues.en: He is still certainly someone that enters the public and the political consciousness there in Pakistan.
cues.zh: 他无疑仍是巴基斯坦公众和政治意识中的重要人物。

cues.en: It's obviously difficult to say exactly how popular he'd be in an election at this exact moment,
cues.zh: 显然，很难准确判断此刻他在选举中会有多受欢迎，

cues.en: but I would not certainly say that he's been written off by the fact that he's been in prison for the course of the last few years.
cues.zh: 但我绝不会说，他过去几年一直入狱就意味着他已被政治抛弃。

cues.en: Far from it.
cues.zh: 远非如此。

cues.en: Carrie Davies in Islamabad.
cues.zh: 凯莉·戴维斯在伊斯兰堡报道。

cues.en: The World Health Organization has announced that the Democratic Republic of Congo will receive
cues.zh: 世界卫生组织宣布，刚果民主共和国将获得

cues.en: 70,000 doses of a vaccine that will help it contain the Ebola outbreak.
cues.zh: 70,000剂疫苗，以帮助控制埃博拉疫情。

cues.en: The Ervebo vaccine has proved effective against the Zaire strain of the virus,
cues.zh: Ervebo疫苗已被证明对这种病毒的扎伊尔毒株有效，

cues.en: but it's not known whether it will protect against the Bundibugyo species behind the current outbreak, which is the fastest spreading on record.
cues.zh: 但尚不清楚它能否预防导致当前疫情的本迪布焦种；这是有记录以来传播最快的一次疫情。

cues.en: The BBC's Africa correspondent Thomas Naadi reports.
cues.zh: BBC非洲记者托马斯·纳迪报道。

cues.en: Director-General of the World Health Organization, Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, says that the vaccine had shown some effectiveness in trials
cues.zh: 世界卫生组织总干事谭德塞说，这种疫苗在试验中对

cues.en: against the rare Bundibugyo strain, which is spreading in DR Congo.
cues.zh: 正在刚果民主共和国传播的罕见本迪布焦毒株显示出一定疗效。

cues.en: Twenty thousand doses are being sent to the country for clinical trials, with the rest for frontline workers.
cues.zh: 其中20,000剂将送往该国用于临床试验，其余供一线工作人员使用。

cues.en: Two separate vaccines specifically designed against the implicated strain are also entering human trials for the first time.
cues.zh: 另外两种专门针对涉事毒株研发的疫苗也首次进入人体试验。

cues.en: So far, 2,378 people are confirmed to have died due to Ebola in DR Congo, with 5,021 confirmed cases.
cues.zh: 目前，刚果民主共和国已有2,378人确认死于埃博拉，确诊病例为5,021例。

cues.en: Dr Tedros previously told the global body's emergency health committee that the disease is far from being under control.
cues.zh: 谭德塞此前告诉全球卫生机构的紧急卫生委员会，这种疾病远未得到控制。

cues.en: Thomas Naadi reporting.
cues.zh: 托马斯·纳迪报道。

cues.en: So, what's happening on the ground in the DRC?
cues.zh: 那么，刚果民主共和国当地情况如何？

cues.en: Trish Newport is the emergency and medical coordinator for the aid charity Médecins Sans Frontières
cues.zh: 特里什·纽波特是援助慈善组织无国界医生的紧急事务和医疗协调员，

cues.en: in Bunia, a city in the northeast of the DRC, which is worst affected by the outbreak.
cues.zh: 她在刚果民主共和国东北部城市布尼亚工作，那里受疫情影响最严重。

cues.en: She's been sharing her thoughts on how they're treating people in very challenging circumstances.
cues.zh: 她分享了自己在极其艰难的环境中救治患者的感受。

cues.en: Today was a very busy day.
cues.zh: 今天非常忙碌。

cues.en: We have a project that was there even before Ebola in a place called Fataki, and we work in a displacement camp.
cues.zh: 我们在法塔基有一个早在埃博拉疫情前就开展的项目，并在一个流离失所者营地工作。

cues.en: It is the most horrific humanitarian situation I have seen in a very, very long time.
cues.zh: 这是我很长很长时间以来见过的最可怕的人道主义局势。

cues.en: Eighty thousand people living in very cramped, horrible conditions, and then Ebola started.
cues.zh: 8万人生活在极其拥挤、恶劣的环境中，随后埃博拉疫情暴发了。

cues.en: And so we built this eight-bed Ebola treatment centre about an hour away from the camp,
cues.zh: 因此，我们在距离营地约一小时路程处建起了这座拥有8张床位的埃博拉治疗中心，

cues.en: and in the last few weeks, the numbers have just exploded, so we've just scaled up to 20 beds.
cues.zh: 过去几周病例数激增，所以我们刚把规模扩大到20张床位。

cues.en: But it's difficult to actually do, because then you have to find all of those staff,
cues.zh: 但实际操作很困难，因为你必须找到所有这些工作人员，

cues.en: and then we need to be training them, making sure that they can work in a safe environment.
cues.zh: 还要培训他们，确保他们能在安全的环境中工作。

cues.en: Because an Ebola treatment centre doesn't just work on its own.
cues.zh: 因为埃博拉治疗中心并不是独立运作的。

cues.en: You actually need to have surveillance, you need to have contact tracing,
cues.zh: 你还必须开展监测和接触者追踪，

cues.en: you need to be able to decontaminate the homes that people are coming from, have ambulance referrals,
cues.zh: 能够为人们离开的住所消毒，并安排救护车转诊，

cues.en: and not forget the absolute humanitarian disaster in the Rhoe camp.
cues.zh: 也不能忘记罗埃营地那场彻底的人道主义灾难。

cues.en: And then something a bit more joyous is we have an Ebola treatment centre in Mambasa, where the outbreak actually started.
cues.zh: 还有一件更令人欣慰的事：我们在疫情实际开始的地方曼巴萨设有一所埃博拉治疗中心。

cues.en: Now, we have 95 people that have survived Ebola from Mambasa, and so we spent time thinking about how to celebrate
cues.zh: 现在，曼巴萨已有95名埃博拉幸存者，因此我们花时间思考如何庆祝

cues.en: the day that we actually have 100 survivors, and how to celebrate with the community, because this is really big news for them.
cues.zh: 达到100名幸存者的那一天，以及如何和社区一起庆祝，因为这对他们来说真是个大新闻。

cues.en: Trish Newport from Médecins Sans Frontières.
cues.zh: 无国界医生组织的特里什·纽波特。

cues.en: One of the problems in tackling the outbreak in the DRC is the relative invisibility of the crisis.
cues.zh: 应对刚果（金）疫情的问题之一，是这场危机相对不受关注。

cues.en: Devi Sridhar is a professor of global public health at the University of Edinburgh.
cues.zh: 德维·斯里达尔是爱丁堡大学全球公共卫生学教授。

cues.en: She's written extensively about this. Paul Henley asked why this Ebola outbreak is getting much less international attention.
cues.zh: 她长期报道此事。保罗·亨利问她，为什么这次埃博拉疫情得到的国际关注少了这么多。

cues.en: Than the previous one in West Africa in 2014.
cues.zh: 比2014年西非上一次疫情少得多。

cues.en: Yeah, it's really puzzling because, actually, like, I think back to working on the 2014 outbreak, and Ebola was, I think, the most googled news term in the world that year.
cues.zh: 是的，这确实令人费解。回想2014年疫情，埃博拉曾是那年全球搜索量最高的新闻词。

cues.en: Almost every day, newspaper headlines and magazine covers featured it. This outbreak is on track to be possibly the second worst—or the worst, on par with that.
cues.zh: 那时几乎每天都有报纸头条和杂志封面报道它。这次疫情可能会成为史上第二严重，甚至最严重的一次，与那次相当。

cues.en: And, yeah, I think it's because everyone's just tired of disease, possibly after the pandemic—maybe COVID-19 fatigue.
cues.zh: 我想，这可能是因为疫情大流行之后，人们已经厌倦了疾病，也许是对新冠的疲劳。

cues.en: No one really wants to hear about infectious diseases, and that may drive producers to think, actually, should we cover this or should we maybe cover something else?
cues.zh: 现在人们不太想听传染病的消息，这也许会让制作人考虑：我们该报道这个，还是换个主题？

cues.en: The public health effort isn't the coordinated international one that it was in 2014, though, is it?
cues.zh: 不过，现在的公共卫生行动，已经不像2014年那样由国际社会协调推进了，对吗？

cues.en: Yeah, thinking back to 2014, the United States, the UK and France provided real leadership. They came together with the World Health Organization to ask, how do we stop this?
cues.zh: 回想2014年，美国、英国和法国政府发挥了真正的领导作用，并与世界卫生组织共同思考：我们该如何阻止疫情？

cues.en: They brought military-like coordination, resources and trained personnel to say, basically, we need to stop this and get on top of it.
cues.zh: 他们带来了军事化的协调、资源和受训人员，基本目标就是控制住疫情。

cues.en: Today, the United States is no longer part of the WHO and is responding alone, making efforts on Ebola.
cues.zh: 如今，美国已不再是世卫组织成员，正单独应对疫情，采取一些埃博拉防控行动。

cues.en: But this is happening in the context of defunding foreign aid and closing USAID.
cues.zh: 但这些行动发生在削减对外援助、关闭美国国际开发署的背景下。

cues.en: The UK is facing its own challenges since Brexit, with domestic issues and the war in Ukraine.
cues.zh: 英国脱欧后也面临自身挑战，包括国内问题和乌克兰战争。

cues.en: I mean, we're in a completely different political environment right now.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，我们现在处于完全不同的政治环境中。

cues.en: This makes it very hard to get collective action globally, make this a priority, and bring in the necessary resources.
cues.zh: 这让全球采取集体行动、将疫情列为优先事项并获得必要资源变得非常困难。

cues.en: Devi Sridhar speaking to Paul Henley.
cues.zh: 德维·斯里达尔接受保罗·亨利采访。

cues.en: Now to a tragic communication error in Australia.
cues.zh: 下面来看澳大利亚发生的一起悲剧性通信错误。

cues.en: Imagine hearing that, after being missing for more than a week, your loved one has been found alive.
cues.zh: 想象一下，亲人失踪一周多后，你听到她还活着、已经被找到的消息。

cues.en: But nine minutes later, you're told they're actually dead.
cues.zh: 但九分钟后，你却被告知她其实已经死亡。

cues.en: That's what happened to Lily Hooper's family. She's an Australian teenager who disappeared while hiking in New South Wales.
cues.zh: 莉莉·胡珀的家人就经历了这一切。她是澳大利亚一名少女，在新南威尔士州徒步时失踪。

cues.en: Helena Burke reports.
cues.zh: 海伦娜·伯克报道。

cues.en: The search continues for a teenager who disappeared while hiking alone.
cues.zh: 搜救仍在继续，一名少女独自徒步时失踪。

cues.en: Police believe 18-year-old Lily Hooper could still be found alive.
cues.zh: 警方相信，18岁的莉莉·胡珀仍可能生还。

cues.en: The bushwalker hasn't been in contact with friends or family since Wednesday.
cues.zh: 这名丛林徒步者自周三起就没有与亲友联系。

cues.en: For more than a week, Australia held its breath as rescuers tried to find Lily Hooper.
cues.zh: 一周多来，澳大利亚屏息以待，救援人员努力寻找莉莉·胡珀。

cues.en: The 18-year-old went missing while hiking alone in the forest on August 12.
cues.zh: 这名18岁少女于8月12日独自在森林徒步时失踪。

cues.en: A large-scale search operation was launched, with rescuers braving freezing temperatures, thick bushland and steep terrain.
cues.zh: 随后展开大规模搜救，救援人员冒着严寒，穿越茂密灌木丛和陡峭地形。

cues.en: Eight days in, news broke that everyone had been hoping for: Lily had been found alive.
cues.zh: 失踪第八天，大家盼望的消息传来：莉莉被找到，而且还活着。

cues.en: The Premier of New South Wales, Chris Minns, interrupted a parliamentary hearing to relay the good news.
cues.zh: 新南威尔士州州长克里斯·明斯打断议会听证会，转达这一好消息。

cues.en: Got some fantastic news, Mr Chair. Lily Hooper's been found alive. I just saw that.
cues.zh: 主席先生，有个极好的消息。莉莉·胡珀被找到，而且还活着。我刚看到消息。

cues.en: Found in the bush with half a bottle of water. With her, so that's fantastic news.
cues.zh: 她是在丛林中被找到的，身边只有半瓶水。这真是个好消息。

cues.en: Videos showed Lily's family cheering, hugging and crying tears of joy.
cues.zh: 视频显示，莉莉的家人欢呼、拥抱，喜极而泣。

cues.en: But as media outlets across Australia reported the news, it suddenly became apparent that there had been a terrible mistake.
cues.zh: 但澳大利亚各地媒体报道这一消息时，人们突然发现，原来发生了可怕的错误。

cues.en: I've got some terrible news, and I apologise to the committee, but it seems the early advice was wrong.
cues.zh: 有个可怕的消息，我向委员会道歉，但看来早先的通知是错的。

cues.en: Can we stop the clock? And Lily's body's been found, and she's been found deceased.
cues.zh: 能暂停计时吗？莉莉的遗体被找到了，她已经死亡。

cues.en: I made the earlier advice, and I'm very sorry for that.
cues.zh: 早先的通知是我发布的，对此我非常抱歉。

cues.en: Joseph Cassar from New South Wales Police said there had been a communication error with the search teams.
cues.zh: 新南威尔士州警方的约瑟夫·卡萨尔说，搜救队伍之间出现了通信错误。

cues.en: The area is thick, dense terrain.
cues.zh: 当地地形复杂、植被茂密。

cues.en: We've got hundreds of searchers out there.
cues.zh: 那里有数百名搜救人员。

cues.en: They're carrying handheld communication devices and, as you can appreciate, sometimes communication is a challenge.
cues.zh: 他们携带手持通信设备，但正如你能理解的，有时通信确实很困难。

cues.en: Police say it was about nine minutes between Lily's family being told she was alive and then being told she was, in fact, dead.
cues.zh: 警方说，莉莉的家人先被告知她还活着，约九分钟后又被告知她其实已经死亡。

cues.en: The head of New South Wales Police, Mal Lanyon, has apologised for the mix-up.
cues.zh: 新南威尔士州警察总长马尔·兰扬为这次混乱道歉。

cues.en: Sadly, this morning, there was a miscommunication when Lily's body was recovered.
cues.zh: 令人遗憾的是，今天早上找到莉莉遗体时，出现了通信错误。

cues.en: That miscommunication—I unashamedly apologise for any additional trauma that may have caused Lily's family.
cues.zh: 这次通信错误给莉莉的家人造成了额外创伤，我对此毫不推诿地道歉。

cues.en: But certainly for the embarrassment and confusion that caused.
cues.zh: 当然，也为由此造成的尴尬和困惑道歉。

cues.en: There will now be an investigation into how the miscommunication occurred.
cues.zh: 现在将调查这次通信错误是如何发生的。

cues.en: A report is also being prepared for the coroner to determine Lily's cause of death.
cues.zh: 同时正在准备报告，供验尸官确定莉莉的死因。

cues.en: Helena Burke.
cues.zh: 海伦娜·伯克。

cues.en: Here in the UK, speculation is rife
cues.zh: 在英国，人们议论纷纷

cues.en: as to what Harry and Meghan, the Duke and Duchess of Sussex,
cues.zh: 哈里和梅根、苏塞克斯公爵和公爵夫人将如何行动

cues.en: will do when they return to the country from the US,
cues.zh: 他们从美国返回英国后会做什么

cues.en: where they've been living for the last six years.
cues.zh: 他们在那里已经生活了六年。

cues.en: The couple don't carry out any official duties for the British royal family,
cues.zh: 这对夫妇不再履行英国王室的任何公务

cues.en: and they no longer act as representatives for Prince Harry's father, King Charles.
cues.zh: 也不再代表哈里的父亲、查尔斯国王。

cues.en: In recent years, Meghan has earned millions of dollars with a lifestyle and cooking series for Netflix,
cues.zh: 近年来，梅根凭借在 Netflix 制作的生活方式与烹饪系列节目赚取了数百万美元

cues.en: but this has been cancelled. So what could be next for her?
cues.zh: 但节目已被取消。她接下来可能做什么？

cues.en: Here's our royal correspondent Daniela Relph.
cues.zh: 以下是王室事务记者丹妮拉·雷尔夫的报道。

cues.en: In all the speculation around why Harry and Meghan are coming back to the UK,
cues.zh: 围绕哈里和梅根为何回英国的种种猜测中

cues.en: could Meghan be about to return to acting?
cues.zh: 梅根是否可能重返演艺圈？

cues.en: There are reports that she has a role in a new UK-based entertainment project,
cues.zh: 有报道称，她将在一个新的英国娱乐项目中出演角色

cues.en: and that is one of the reasons why the family is leaving America.
cues.zh: 这也是这个家庭离开美国的原因之一。

cues.en: Harry and Meghan's team has not denied the story, but aren't giving any details at this stage
cues.zh: 哈里和梅根的团队没有否认这一消息，但目前没有透露任何细节

cues.en: of what Meghan's new role is.
cues.zh: 也没有说明梅根的新角色是什么。

cues.en: Her acting career has pretty much been on hold since her marriage to Harry.
cues.zh: 自从与哈里结婚以来，她的演艺事业基本处于停滞状态。

cues.en: Her most famous role within the US-based legal drama Suits
cues.zh: 她最著名的角色是在美国法律剧《金装律师》中

cues.en: where for seven seasons she played the lawyer Rachel Zane.
cues.zh: 她在剧中七季都饰演律师瑞秋·赞恩。

cues.en: A return to acting could be lucrative for Meghan.
cues.zh: 重返演艺圈可能为梅根带来丰厚收入。

cues.en: There will be huge interest in whatever she does in this space,
cues.zh: 无论她在这一领域做什么，都会引起极大关注

cues.en: as the Sussexes' UK return continues to grab attention.
cues.zh: 因为苏塞克斯夫妇回英国一事持续受到关注。

cues.en: Daniela Relph.
cues.zh: 丹妮拉·雷尔夫。

cues.en: Still to come in this podcast.
cues.zh: 本期节目稍后还有。

cues.en: Now, this whole line of inquiry has now been undermined by the news that the kidney being studied was not that of Diego Armando Maradona.
cues.zh: 如今，所研究的肾脏并非迭戈·阿曼多·马拉多纳的，这一消息削弱了整条调查思路。

cues.en: It was that of his father.
cues.zh: 那是他父亲的肾脏。

cues.en: The trial over the death of football legend Maradona is halted
cues.zh: 足球传奇马拉多纳死亡案的审判暂停

cues.en: following a kidney test mix-up.
cues.zh: 原因是肾脏检测出现混淆。

cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast.
cues.zh: 这里是《Global News Podcast》。

cues.en: The Trump administration is ramping up the pressure on Cuba with a new raft of sanctions
cues.zh: 特朗普政府通过新一轮制裁加大对古巴的压力

cues.en: targeting various individuals and organizations. The US Secretary of State Marco Rubio announced the new restrictions on Thursday.
cues.zh: 目标包括多个个人和组织。美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥周四宣布了这些新限制。

cues.en: Cuba's UN representative Ernesto Soberón Guzmán denounced the sanctions
cues.zh: 古巴驻联合国代表埃内斯托·索贝隆·古斯曼谴责这些制裁

cues.en: and warned that any US military action against the Caribbean island would have serious repercussions.
cues.zh: 并警告称，任何针对这个加勒比岛屿的美国军事行动都将产生严重后果。

cues.en: Should a military adventure against Cuba be launched, the consequences will be immeasurable.
cues.zh: 如果对古巴发动军事冒险，后果将无法估量。

cues.en: It will not only affect Cuba and the US, but also jeopardize peace, security and stability
cues.zh: 这不仅会影响古巴和美国，还会危及和平、安全与稳定

cues.en: in the Western Hemisphere and even the entire world.
cues.zh: 以及西半球乃至全世界。

cues.en: The US has already imposed many sanctions on Cuba.
cues.zh: 美国已经对古巴实施了许多制裁。

cues.en: I asked Luis Fajardo from BBC Monitoring if these new ones would make any difference.
cues.zh: 我询问了 BBC 监测部的路易斯·法哈尔多，这些新制裁是否会带来不同。

cues.en: Alex, it is one more step in, as you mentioned, the continued intense
cues.zh: 亚历克斯，正如你所说，这是美国持续施加的强大压力中的又一步

cues.en: economic pressure that the United States is putting on Cuba.
cues.zh: 美国正把这种经济压力施加于古巴。

cues.en: This round of sanctions affects three officials who were involved in a more political role in an agency
cues.zh: 这一轮制裁针对三名官员，他们在某机构中担任更具政治性的职务

cues.en: that the US says was, quote-unquote, exporting communist subversion to other countries.
cues.zh: 美国称该机构在“向其他国家输出共产主义颠覆活动”。

cues.en: And it also involves sanctions on nine agencies in things like the Ministry of Construction,
cues.zh: 制裁还涉及九个机构，包括建设部等部门

cues.en: a company involved in nickel mining, which traditionally has been an important source of money for Cuba.
cues.zh: 以及一家镍矿企业；镍矿传统上一直是古巴的重要收入来源。

cues.en: So it is part of a continued effort by the US to weaken the Cuban economy,
cues.zh: 因此，这是美国持续削弱古巴经济的一部分

cues.en: on top of great restrictions, for example, on oil, on fuel and all kinds of things that are causing a great deal of disruption in the Cuban economy.
cues.zh: 此外，石油、燃料等方面的严格限制，也给古巴经济造成了巨大混乱。

cues.en: How are ordinary Cubans coping at the moment?
cues.zh: 普通古巴人目前如何应对？

cues.en: They're facing a lot of disruption in their everyday life.
cues.zh: 他们的日常生活正面临许多混乱。

cues.en: Energy shortages are leading to big power outages, very frequent across the country.
cues.zh: 能源短缺导致大规模停电，而且停电在全国十分频繁。

cues.en: There are shortages of basic goods and there's a sense of serious economic deterioration, inflation, all kinds of things.
cues.zh: 基本商品短缺，经济严重恶化，还有通货膨胀等各种问题。

cues.en: And besides, a traditional escape valve for the island, which was immigration to the US, of course, is much, much more restricted nowadays.
cues.zh: 此外，这个岛国过去的传统出路——移民美国——如今当然也受到更多限制。

cues.en: So, all in all, a very difficult situation for Cubans trying to withstand this economic pressure by the US.
cues.zh: 总而言之，古巴人试图承受美国经济压力，处境十分艰难。

cues.en: What's the US trying to achieve?
cues.zh: 美国想达到什么目的？

cues.en: Well, the United States, particularly the Trump administration, has been saying that they want political change in the island
cues.zh: 美国，尤其是特朗普政府，一直表示希望这个岛国发生政治变革

cues.en: and specifically in Miami, where I am based, of course, many people think and hope that this time they would manage to do it.
cues.zh: 特别是在我所在的迈阿密，许多人认为并希望这次他们能够做到。

cues.en: There's been a lot of speculation in the media that the US was trying to look for a Venezuelan-type
cues.zh: 媒体上有很多猜测，认为美国正试图寻找一种委内瑞拉式的

cues.en: scenario where someone in the Cuban administration would agree for a takeover with the US and cooperate somehow with the US.
cues.zh: 局面：古巴政府中有人同意与美国合作，由美国接管政权。

cues.en: This is a government that has been extremely resilient over the decades.
cues.zh: 这个政府几十年来一直极具韧性。

cues.en: Many, many different US governments have tried to change the political situation in Cuba and have failed.
cues.zh: 许多届不同的美国政府都曾试图改变古巴的政治局势，但都失败了。

cues.en: So it is very difficult just to assume that this time they're going to be successful.
cues.zh: 因此，很难简单认定这次他们会成功。

cues.en: I was going to say, is it going to be different this time?
cues.zh: 我正想问，这次会有所不同吗？

cues.en: People in Miami say that very few times Cuba has faced such a harsh economic crisis,
cues.zh: 迈阿密的人说，古巴很少面对如此严峻的经济危机

cues.en: but again, this is a government that has gone through a lot, that has withstood a lot of pressure, and it is very hard to discount.
cues.zh: 但再次强调，这是一个历经磨难、承受过巨大压力的政府，很难低估它。

cues.en: Luis Fajardo from BBC Monitoring.
cues.zh: BBC 监测部的路易斯·法哈尔多。

cues.en: There's yet more drama in the legal wrangling over the death of Diego Maradona, and it's all down to kidneys.
cues.zh: 围绕迭戈·马拉多纳死因的法律纠纷又有了新戏剧，而这一切都与肾脏有关。

cues.en: The Argentine football legend died in 2020, but since then a case to determine if anyone's responsible has collapsed.
cues.zh: 这位阿根廷足球传奇于2020年去世，此后确认是否有人应负责任的案件已经流产。

cues.en: Now another trial has been put on hold after medical experts admitted the information they analysed about his kidneys was actually about his father.
cues.zh: 医疗专家承认，他们分析的有关马拉多纳肾脏的信息其实涉及他的父亲，另一场审判因此暂停。

cues.en: Who died in 2015 and was also called Diego Maradona.
cues.zh: 他的父亲于2015年去世，也叫迭戈·马拉多纳。

cues.en: The South American football expert Tim Vickery told us more about this mix-up.
cues.zh: 南美足球专家蒂姆·维克里为我们进一步讲述了这起混淆。

cues.en: Oh, it's an extraordinary story. It's every bit as meandering as the life of Maradona himself.
cues.zh: 这真是个非同寻常的故事，和马拉多纳本人的一生一样曲折。

cues.en: The first trial collapsed because one of the judges was collaborating with a documentary television programme.
cues.zh: 第一次审判流产了，因为其中一名法官在与一档电视纪录片合作。

cues.en: It clearly had an editorial line that the defendants were guilty.
cues.zh: 那档节目显然预设了被告有罪的编辑立场。

cues.en: So we had to dust ourselves down and do the whole thing over again.
cues.zh: 所以他们只好重整旗鼓，把整个过程再来一遍。

cues.en: The death of Maradona in 2020.
cues.zh: 马拉多纳于2020年去世。

cues.en: The accusation from a medical board in Argentina is that his treatment was inadequate, deficient and reckless.
cues.zh: 阿根廷一个医疗委员会指控，他接受的治疗不充分、有缺陷且鲁莽。

cues.en: What they're saying is that the medical professionals were treating Maradona as if he had a mental problem with addiction,
cues.zh: 他们的说法是，医护人员把马拉多纳当作有成瘾心理问题的人来治疗，

cues.en: when there were far more pressing physical elements to be looked at that weren't examined sufficiently.
cues.zh: 而当时还有更紧迫的身体问题需要检查，却没有得到充分检查。

cues.en: And part of this was Diego Maradona's kidneys.
cues.zh: 马拉多纳的肾脏就是其中一部分。

cues.en: The liver specialist was giving testimony earlier this week when he said, "Look at the kidney. Look at it."
cues.zh: 本周早些时候，一名肝脏专家作证时说：“看看这个肾脏，看看它。”

cues.en: This is the kidney of someone who has suffered the ravages of obesity, hypertension and cocaine use,
cues.zh: 这是一个饱受肥胖、高血压和吸食可卡因摧残的人的肾脏，

cues.en: and no blood tests were being carried out. This is clear negligence.
cues.zh: 而且当时没有进行血液检查。这显然是疏忽。

cues.en: Now this whole line of inquiry has been undermined by the news that the kidney being studied was not that of Diego Armando Maradona.
cues.zh: 如今，所研究的肾脏并非迭戈·阿曼多·马拉多纳的，这一消息动摇了整条调查思路。

cues.en: It was that of his father, and it's no wonder that the kidney was in an advanced state,
cues.zh: 那是他父亲的肾脏，难怪它已经处于严重病变状态，

cues.en: because Diego Maradona's father was 33 years older than Diego Maradona.
cues.zh: 因为马拉多纳的父亲比马拉多纳年长33岁。

cues.en: So they've been looking at the wrong kidney. How on earth has this happened?
cues.zh: 所以他们一直研究的是错误的肾脏。这到底是怎么发生的？

cues.en: There will be a full investigation of the medical facility concerned.
cues.zh: 有关方面将对涉事医疗机构展开全面调查。

cues.en: The other question is, where on earth does this leave the trial?
cues.zh: 另一个问题是，这到底会让审判走向何方？

cues.en: This would seem to greatly undermine the evidence given by this medical board, and so at the moment we really don't know where the whole thing stands.
cues.zh: 这似乎会极大削弱该医疗委员会提供的证据，所以目前我们确实不知道整件事进展如何。

cues.en: Tim Vickery.
cues.zh: 蒂姆·维克里报道。

cues.en: Bangladesh, Uganda, Saudi Arabia and the Bahamas are just some of the countries where attempting suicide is against the law.
cues.zh: 孟加拉国、乌干达、沙特阿拉伯和巴哈马，只是一些将自杀未遂定为违法的国家。

cues.en: In Nigeria, trying to take your own life is punishable by up to a year in prison, a fine or both. But that will soon change.
cues.zh: 在尼日利亚，试图结束自己的生命可处一年以下监禁、罚款，或两者并罚。但这种情况很快会改变。

cues.en: The Nigerian government approved plans to decriminalize it, a significant policy shift in a country where mental illness remains heavily stigmatized.
cues.zh: 尼日利亚政府刚刚批准将其去罪化的计划；在一个精神疾病仍受严重污名化的国家，这是一项重大的政策转变。

cues.en: Ankur Desai asked our Africa correspondent Simi Jolaoso in Lagos why this decision had been taken.
cues.zh: 安库尔·德赛在拉各斯询问了我们的非洲记者西米·乔拉奥索，为何作出这一决定。

cues.en: The Nigerian government's decision is essentially based on the argument that attempted suicide should be treated
cues.zh: 尼日利亚政府的决定，本质上基于这样的观点：自杀未遂应被视为

cues.en: as a mental health and public health emergency rather than as a criminal act.
cues.zh: 一种心理健康和公共卫生紧急事件，而不是刑事行为。

cues.en: So the country's health minister, Professor Muhammad Ali Pate, called suicide a major public health concern
cues.zh: 该国卫生部长穆罕默德·阿里·帕特教授称，自杀是一个重大的公共卫生问题，

cues.en: and said that there are around 300,000 suicide attempts every year and at least 7,000 deaths.
cues.zh: 并说每年约有30万起自杀未遂，至少有7,000人死亡。

cues.en: He said people who attempt suicide should be regarded as people who need care and support rather than prosecution.
cues.zh: 他说，应将自杀未遂者视为需要照护和支持的人，而不是起诉对象。

cues.en: So his argument is that removing that threat of arrest could make it easier for people in crisis and their families
cues.zh: 所以他的论点是，消除被逮捕的威胁，能让处于危机中的人及其家人更容易

cues.en: to seek help and then for health professionals to intervene.
cues.zh: 寻求帮助，也让卫生专业人员介入。

cues.en: And if we talk about Nigeria itself, mental illness is stigmatized in the country. Why is that?
cues.zh: 说到尼日利亚本身，精神疾病在这个国家受到污名化。为什么会这样？

cues.en: The stigma around mental illnesses in Nigeria is deeply rooted in a combination of cultural beliefs and religion,
cues.zh: 尼日利亚对精神疾病的污名，深深植根于文化信仰和宗教，

cues.en: a lack of mental health literacy and the historical lack of accessible psychiatric care.
cues.zh: 以及心理健康知识匮乏和长期缺少可获得的精神科医疗服务。

cues.en: In many Nigerian communities, mental illness can be interpreted as witchcraft or a spiritual attack rather than as a medical condition.
cues.zh: 在许多尼日利亚社区，精神疾病可能被解释为巫术或灵魂攻击，而非一种医学疾病。

cues.en: So there's essentially a lack of understanding about what mental illness actually looks like and that it's not always physical.
cues.zh: 因此，人们基本不了解精神疾病究竟是什么样，也不了解它并不总是表现为身体症状。

cues.en: And coupled with the shortage of mental health services, that reinforces the problem.
cues.zh: 再加上心理健康服务短缺，这进一步强化了问题。

cues.en: According to the Association of Psychiatrists in Nigeria, there are fewer than 1,000 psychiatrists
cues.zh: 据尼日利亚精神科医生协会称，该国精神科医生不足1,000名，

cues.en: for a country with a population of more than 200 million people.
cues.zh: 而这个国家的人口超过2亿。

cues.en: The strongest research available does not show that countries with criminal penalties have consistently lower suicide rates.
cues.zh: 现有最有力的研究并未显示，将自杀未遂入罪的国家自杀率一贯更低。

cues.en: Many health organisations also argue that criminalisation can actually increase stigma and discourage people from seeking help
cues.zh: 许多卫生组织还认为，将其入罪实际上会加重污名，并阻碍人们寻求帮助，

cues.en: which is what the Nigerian government is trying to work at here.
cues.zh: 这正是尼日利亚政府试图在此解决的问题。

cues.en: The International Association for Suicide Prevention says it's an important stepping stone in suicide prevention,
cues.zh: 国际自杀预防协会称，这是自杀预防的重要一步，

cues.en: but stresses that it must be accompanied by wider measures, such as accessible mental health services and national suicide prevention strategies.
cues.zh: 但强调必须辅以更广泛的措施，例如人人可及的心理健康服务和国家自杀预防战略。

cues.en: The organisation also says that at least 23 countries still criminalise suicide, but it seems that soon Nigeria won't be one of them.
cues.zh: 该组织还说，至少仍有23个国家将自杀未遂入罪，但尼日利亚似乎很快就不会是其中之一。

cues.en: Simi Jolaoso.
cues.zh: 西米·乔拉奥索报道。

cues.en: And finally, when you start a book, do you always finish reading it?
cues.zh: 最后，开始读一本书后，你总会读完吗？

cues.en: Or if it doesn't immediately transport you, do you toss it aside?
cues.zh: 还是说，如果它没能立刻带你进入书中，你就会把它搁置一旁？

cues.en: And crucially, if you do the latter, will you keep it a secret?
cues.zh: 更重要的是，如果你选择后者，会把这件事藏起来吗？

cues.en: Fearing not finishing is a sign of intellectual failure on your part.
cues.zh: 因为你担心读不完会被视为智力上的失败？

cues.en: Well, now DNF, which stands for "Did Not Finish", is being used almost as a badge of honour.
cues.zh: 如今，DNF是“未读完”的缩写，几乎成了一种荣誉徽章。

cues.en: Earlier this year, the world's biggest website for readers, Goodreads, introduced a DNF feature
cues.zh: 今年早些时候，全球最大的读者网站 Goodreads 推出了 DNF 功能，

cues.en: to sit alongside other categories relating to featured books, including "Want to Read" and "Read".
cues.zh: 与“想读”和“已读”等其他图书分类并列。

cues.en: Kathy Rentzenbrink is a memoirist and author of "Dear Reader: The Comfort and Joy of Books".
cues.zh: 凯茜·伦岑布林克是回忆录作家，也是《亲爱的读者：书籍带来的慰藉与喜悦》的作者。

cues.en: Alex Clark is a writer and literary critic.
cues.zh: 亚历克斯·克拉克是作家和文学评论家。

cues.en: First, Katie Razzall asked Kathy if she always feels like she has to finish a book.
cues.zh: 凯蒂·拉扎尔先问凯茜，她是否总觉得自己必须读完一本书。

cues.en: No, I don't. And I actually think in general people don't have to finish books.
cues.zh: 不必。我其实认为，一般来说，人们不必读完每一本书。

cues.en: I think the right book is out there for everyone.
cues.zh: 我认为，每个人都能找到适合自己的书。

cues.en: So even if somebody thinks they don't like reading, they just haven't met the right book yet. They're probably put off by school.
cues.zh: 所以，即使有人觉得自己不喜欢阅读，也只是还没遇到合适的书。他们可能是因为上学时的经历而对阅读望而却步。

cues.en: So I don't think it's helpful for people to think that they have to slog on with something they're not enjoying.
cues.zh: 所以，我不认为让人们觉得必须苦撑着读完不喜欢的东西会有帮助。

cues.en: I think it'd be better to move on to something else and think that reading should just be a beautiful, sumptuous, fantastic pleasure.
cues.zh: 我认为，最好换读别的东西，并相信阅读就该是一种美好、丰盛而奇妙的享受。

cues.en: Presumably you hope your books will be a sumptuous pleasure for people.
cues.zh: 想必你也希望自己的书能给读者带来丰盛的乐趣。

cues.en: You don't want them tossing them aside, or are you relaxed about that too?
cues.zh: 你当然不希望他们把书搁在一旁；还是说，对此你也很看得开？

cues.en: Well, no, I do want them to be! I do want them to be pleasurable, and I think about the reader a lot.
cues.zh: 不，我当然希望它们能带来乐趣！我确实希望它们令人愉悦，也经常考虑读者。

cues.en: But near the beginning of my book about writing, I said,
cues.zh: 不过，我写的那本关于写作的书开头不久，我就说：

cues.en: "Look, if this book isn't for you, just put it down and find something else."
cues.zh: “听着，如果这本书不适合你，就放下它，去找别的书吧。”

cues.en: But my editor wanted me to take that out!
cues.zh: 但我的编辑想让我删掉这句话！

cues.en: Again, I think that not everyone will be for everyone.
cues.zh: 不过，我还是认为，不会有一本书适合所有人。

cues.en: I probably wouldn't use "Did Not Finish"; it sounds a bit cruel.
cues.zh: 我大概不会用“未读完”，因为听起来有点刻薄。

cues.en: I'd just go for "Not my bag". That's what I say when I don't like something. It's someone else's bag, but it's just not my bag.
cues.zh: 我会说“不合我的口味”。我不喜欢某样东西时就这么说。它可能合别人的口味，只是不合我的口味。

cues.en: And Alex Clark, "not my bag" and toss it aside, or what do you think?
cues.zh: 亚历克斯·克拉克，你会说“不合我的口味”然后把书搁下吗？你怎么看？

cues.en: I think it is perfectly fine to read or not read a book, put it aside, come back to it later,
cues.zh: 我认为，读不读一本书都完全没问题；可以把它放下，之后再回来读，

cues.en: decide it's the worst thing that you've ever read, or throw it away.
cues.zh: 也可以认定它是你读过最糟的东西，或者把它扔掉。

cues.en: What I am bemused by is this idea that you would need to publicly catalogue that.
cues.zh: 让我困惑的是，为什么你需要把这件事公开记录下来。

cues.en: This is the DNF phenomenon. Exactly.
cues.zh: 这就是 DNF 现象。没错。

cues.en: It's sort of slightly bewilders me.
cues.zh: 这多少让我有些不解。

cues.en: It's almost like kind of anti-gatekeeping.
cues.zh: 它几乎有点像反门槛文化。

cues.en: It's people saying, "Don't worry, you don't have to read this. It's fine."
cues.zh: 就像人们在说：“别担心，你不必读这本书，没关系。”

cues.en: It's the idea that you hang this albatross around the neck of a book that might be absolutely somebody else's bag.
cues.zh: 这就像把一块沉重的负担挂在一本书的脖子上，而它可能完全合另一个人的口味。

cues.en: It seems less about reading and more about the psychology of display and private life to me.
cues.zh: 在我看来，这似乎与阅读关系不大，更多关乎展示心理和私人生活。

cues.en: And so you would never put DNF on any online site?
cues.zh: 所以，你绝不会在任何网站上标记 DNF？

cues.en: I don't think I would want to tell anyone because I'd have that sort of fear that you were labeling something.
cues.zh: 我想我不会告诉任何人，因为我会担心自己给某样东西贴上了标签。

cues.en: It carries a negative connotation even if you are firmly saying, "This isn't for me."
cues.zh: 即使你明确是在说“这不适合我”，它仍带有负面意味。

cues.en: And I think that is absolutely fine, but I think it's also important to say that things are for people at different times.
cues.zh: 我认为这完全没问题，但也要说清楚：不同的事物适合人们的不同阶段。

cues.en: You vibe with books, don't vibe with them.
cues.zh: 你可能与某些书合拍，也可能合不来。

cues.en: Find they've got something to say to you, feel very irritated by them.
cues.zh: 你可能觉得它们有话想对你说，也可能被它们弄得非常恼火。

cues.en: Depending on what's happening in your life at the time, where your emotions are, and that's absolutely fine.
cues.zh: 这取决于当时你的生活状况和情绪，而这完全没问题。

cues.en: Why you would need to tell anybody else about it is slightly beyond me, but perhaps I'm just old.
cues.zh: 为什么要把这些告诉别人，我有点无法理解；不过，也许只是我老了。

cues.en: Kathy, what do you think about the DNF phenomenon? Would you ever put it up beside a book?
cues.zh: 凯茜，你怎么看 DNF 现象？你会把它标在一本书旁边吗？

cues.en: I might say that privately to a friend, but I'd never put that online because I am a writer.
cues.zh: 我可能会私下对朋友这么说，但绝不会放到网上，因为我是作家。

cues.en: So I know how horrible it is. I'm thinking right now,
cues.zh: 所以我知道那有多糟。我现在就在想，

cues.en: Maybe someone's listening and thinking, "Let's Google how often people have said DNF about her rubbish books,"
cues.zh: 也许有人正在收听，心想：“搜搜看，人们有多少次说她的书糟糕到 DNF，”

cues.en: and then they'll tell me about it!
cues.zh: 然后再把结果告诉我！

cues.en: Well, everyone's wishing you well. They're going to buy your book now.
cues.zh: 大家都在祝你一切顺利。他们现在要去买你的书了。

cues.en: Kathy Rentzenbrink and Alex Clark speaking to Katie Razzall.
cues.zh: 凯茜·伦岑布林克和亚历克斯·克拉克接受了凯蒂·拉扎尔的采访。

cues.en: And that's all from us for now.
cues.zh: 以上就是目前的全部内容。

cues.en: If you want to get in touch, you can email us at globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk.
cues.zh: 如果你想联系我们，可以发送邮件至 globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk。

cues.en: You can also find us on X at BBC World Service. Use the hashtag #GlobalNewsPod.
cues.zh: 你也可以在 X 上通过 BBC World Service 找到我们，使用话题标签 #GlobalNewsPod。

cues.en: And don't forget our sister podcast, The Global Story, which goes in depth and beyond the headlines on one big story.
cues.zh: 别忘了我们的姊妹播客《全球故事》，它会围绕一个重大故事深入探究，超越新闻标题。

cues.en: This edition of the Global News Podcast was mixed by Rosewyn Dorrell, and the producer was Emma Joseph.
cues.zh: 本期《全球新闻播客》由罗斯温·多雷尔混音，制片人是艾玛·约瑟夫。

cues.en: The editor is Karen Martin. I'm Alex Ritson. Until next time, goodbye.
cues.zh: 编辑是凯伦·马丁。我是亚历克斯·里特森。下次再见。
